incident-bot: PAGE FIRED: quota-anomaly-serviceX - 429 spike detected on /v1/generate - severity=high - links: https://dash.company.internal/d/abc/alerts
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-79234 triggered (high) — Unusual quota enforcement; paging on-call
Maya (oncall-sre): acked — I'm on it :raised_hand:
Maya (oncall-sre): quick snapshot: 01:03 UTC baseline 429s ~5/s -> 01:07 UTC spike ~220/s. Error type = "quota_mismatch" from quota-mapper v2.1.4
Priya (runtime): I'm seeing quota-mapper returned 500s for tenant lookup: sample logs:
```
2026-03-14T01:07:12Z ERROR quota-mapper GET /tenant/lookup id=tenant-T42 status=500 body="internal error"
2026-03-14T01:07:13Z WARN policy-fallback tenant=T42 fallback=deny
```
Priya (runtime): fallback policy currently set to `deny` on gateway which causes instant 429s when mapper fails
Tom (infra-eng): which cluster? production-primary-east
Maya (oncall-sre): correct — prod-primary-east. Initial mitigation plan: flip fallback to `permissive` (fail-open) on the gateway and disable quota-mapper sticky routing. Then monitor 429s and token rate.
Maya (oncall-sre): Command to run (checked with infra playbook):
```
kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/api-gateway QUOTA_FALLBACK=permissive --context=prod-east
kubectl -n gateway annotate svc quota-mapper enable-routing=false --context=prod-east
```
deploy-bot: rollouts initiated for api-gateway env patch — rollout id r-202603140107
Tom (infra-eng): disabling quota-mapper routing now (toggle pushed). Will restart a small subset first.
Tom (infra-eng): done for nodepool-a subset. Pushed permissive fallback to 3/6 pods. Monitoring.
Maya (oncall-sre): metrics update: 429s dropped from ~220/s to ~18/s within 3 minutes. Latency unchanged. Good sign.
Nate (customer-sre): customer-impact: CS reported errors for tenants T42 and T88; both are on throttled plan. Notified account owners and opened interim ticket.
Jules (product): any customer-facing message needed now? Nate: we'll do a brief status note — no billing impact expected, behavior temporary.
Tom (infra-eng): rolled change across remaining pods. Quota-mapper service shows OOM in logs right before the failure window; attaching log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T01:06:59Z ERROR quota-mapper OOMKilled pid=4321 rss=1.9G
```
Priya (runtime): runtime keeps fallback permissive for now. Suggest reverting only after quota-mapper patch/upgrade.
Maya (oncall-sre): handing off to infra for RCA and permanent fix. Current status: mitigated, error rates returned to baseline.
Maya (oncall-sre): PD incident INC-79234 will be acknowledged and closed once infra confirms stability for 30m. On-call rotation: I'll remain available for 15m then hand back.
Tom (infra-eng): I'll spin a repair build of quota-mapper with memory fix and a canary deploy to prod-east. PR #1342 created.
Jules (product): schedule postmortem and include customer-impact timeline and eval of fallback policies as action items.
Maya (oncall-sre): thanks everyone — closing the page on this thread, follow-ups in #postmortems and the RCA doc. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Incident INC-79234 status: acknowledged -> resolved (mitigated) at 01:45 UTC
Maya (oncall-sre): final note: mitigation was to set QUOTA_FALLBACK=permissive + disable routing to quota-mapper; root cause looks like OOM crash in quota-mapper leading to misapplied quotas. RCA owner: Tom. Action items: memory bump + graceful failover + alert tuning.
